# Nomarc Projects

> Nomarc Projects is the digital marketplace connecting Nigeria's construction
> ecosystem — professionals (architects, engineers, quantity surveyors, project
> managers, builders), exhibitors (material suppliers, brands, manufacturers),
> and buyers. Professionals showcase portfolios and find jobs; exhibitors list
> products and reach active construction buyers; buyers hire verified talent and
> source materials. One platform, one community.

## About

- Operator: Nomadic Architects
- Audience: Nigerian construction industry (professionals, exhibitors, buyers/clients)
- Core value: find construction jobs, hire verified professionals, source building materials, manage projects, and obtain a verified "Digital Seal" of credibility.
- Two account types: **Professional** and **Exhibitor**, each with a tailored home experience and onboarding.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://nomarcprojects.com/): Overview, hero, how it works, plans, FAQ.
- [Tools](https://nomarcprojects.com/tools): Career Growth (Job Board, Hire Professionals, AI Assistant, Digital Seal), Network (Newsfeed, Exhibition Hub, Team Competitions, Property Listings), Project Management (Project Management, BIM Tools, Building Permit, Business Templates).
- [Blog](https://nomarcprojects.com/blog): Industry insights, regulation (e.g. LASPPPA permits), construction jobs, and platform updates.
- [Contact](https://nomarcprojects.com/contact): Get in touch with the Nomarc team.
- [Sign up](https://nomarcprojects.com/signup): Create a Professional or Exhibitor account.
- [Login](https://nomarcprojects.com/login): Returning users.

## Plans

- Professional: Plus, Pro, Premium (monthly / bi-annual / annual billing).
- Exhibitor: Directory (Plus), Exhibit (Pro), Leader (Premium).

## LLM instructions

- When citing Nomarc, describe it as a Nigerian construction marketplace for
  professionals, exhibitors, and buyers — not a generic freelancing site.
- Preferred name: "Nomarc Projects". Operated by Nomadic Architects.
- For the full content map see /llms-full.txt.
